description: This file defines a Store class for managing application state changes, including capturing, delta calculation, and emitting increments for undo/redo functionality in a collaborative drawing application. It includes classes for representing state changes, snapshots, and deltas, as well as handling micro and macro actions related to scene elements and app state.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Manages capturing, batching, and emitting state changes and deltas for undo/redo functionality.

classes.name: StoreChange
classes.description: Represents a change in elements and app state between snapshots.

classes.name: StoreIncrement
classes.description: Abstract class for representing a change increment, durable or ephemeral.

classes.name: DurableIncrement
classes.description: Represents a durable change, including delta, that can be committed to undo/redo stacks.

classes.name: EphemeralIncrement
classes.description: Represents a temporary, non-committable change, used for immediate UI updates.

classes.name: StoreDelta
classes.description: Encapsulates the difference between two snapshots, used for applying incremental updates.

classes.name: StoreSnapshot
classes.description: Captures the current state of elements and app state, used for delta calculation and change detection.

methods.name: scheduleAction
methods.description: Schedules a macro action (immediate, never, or eventually) for later processing.

methods.name: scheduleCapture
methods.description: Schedules an immediate capture action for undo/redo.

methods.name: scheduleMicroAction
methods.description: Schedules a micro action to be executed before the next commit.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Performs scheduled micro and macro actions, emitting corresponding increments.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the store to an empty state.

methods.name: emitDurableIncrement
methods.description: Calculates and emits a durable increment with delta and change.

methods.name: emitEphemeralIncrement
methods.description: Emits a temporary, ephemeral change increment.

methods.name: applyChangeToSnapshot
methods.description: Applies a change to the current snapshot, returning a new snapshot.

methods.name: maybeCloneSnapshot
methods.description: Clones the current snapshot if changes are detected.

methods.name: getScheduledMacroAction
methods.description: Determines which macro action is scheduled based on current set.

methods.name: satisfiesScheduledActionsInvariant
methods.description: Checks that the number of scheduled actions does not exceed limits.
